BrochureContent.Content:
Situated in the heart of Nenagh, No. 7 Friar Street is a well presented two bedroom end of terrace property with the added benefit of a converted attic space. 
The property comprises two bedrooms and two bathrooms and was refurbished in recent years.

The ground floor features an open-plan living and dining area with a solid fuel stove and kitchenette. On the first floor, there are two bedrooms and a fully tiled family bathroom. The second floor contains a converted attic room along with an additional bathroom.

Externally, the property benefits from a small rear yard and storage shed.

This property would make an ideal first-time home or investment opportunity, and viewing is highly recommended.
